input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 9 provides only termination for breach, insolvency and Vendor performance failures (numbering skips 9.4) — there is no convenience right for Customer in a three-year term, and Section 2.1 expressly denies termination rights, which is our walk-away position. We inserted a new Section 9.4 giving Customer a 30-day convenience right with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and no early-termination charge, and confirming Vendor has no mid-term convenience exit.

input.quote: thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewals are 12 months (not multi-year), the non-renewal window is only 30 days and runs against Customer alone, Vendor must send a 60-day reminder with the deadline tolled if it fails, and Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. This matches our preferred position; no redline needed.
